title: South Ocean Gallery at South Nassau Unitarian Universalist Congregation
summary: South Ocean Gallery at South Nassau Unitarian Universalist Congregation in Freeport is the venue for Living Conduit - Indigenous History and Present Day, a fall 2026 exhibition by Shinnecock artist Jeremy Dennis.
map_geometry_source: Public venue address geocoded from 228 South Ocean Avenue, Freeport, NY.
why_this_matters: This Freeport venue is part of the modern acknowledgment landscape for Merrick/Freeport-area Indigenous history. The 2026 Living Conduit exhibition connects On This Site place research with contemporary Shinnecock portraiture, education, and continuing Long Island Indigenous presence.
introduction_content: The exhibition connects On This Site landscapes of Freeport and Merrick/Meroke ancestral lands with the Shinnecock Portrait Project, pairing place-based histories of erasure with portraits and interviews that affirm the ongoing presence and survivance of Long Island Indigenous communities. [1. SNUUC On This Site and Portrait Show pre-publicity draft; SNUUC On This Site exhibition project outline.]
history_content: The exhibit is scheduled for viewing from October 3 to November 21, 2026. Programming includes a meet-the-artist opening reception on October 17, 2026, and an artist talk with activity on October 24, 2026. School visits are expected by arrangement during the exhibition period. The pin marks the gallery venue for the exhibit, not sensitive archaeological locations or private places.
preservation_content: For more information, email Diane Hawkins at parkviewdesign@verizon.net.
whereintheworld_content: The gallery is located at South Nassau Unitarian Universalist Congregation, 228 South Ocean Avenue in Freeport, New York.
